text:
Tess (People Ops): quick heads-up — launching a short-lived "Emergency Travel Fund" and a micro policy change for company-sponsored travel. Details below.

Marco (People Ops): Summary: one-time advances up to $1,500 for time-sensitive family or medical travel; same-day reviews for submissions before 3pm PT. Also a $300 backup-care micro-grant for last-minute care.

Jess (Eng): Does the fund cover urgent passport/visa expedite fees?

Tess (People Ops): Yes — expedite fees and direct travel costs are eligible. Include the confirmation/receipt and a one-line reason in the form.

Hannah (Payroll): Accounting tag: "Emergency Travel Fund". Advances < $1.5k processed as a payroll advance. Repayment options: payroll spread over up to 2 cycles or immediate card debit. If conversion to a grant is needed, People Ops + manager sign-off required.

Oren (Legal): Note: international evacuations or cross-border medical repatriation may require Security + Legal coordination. Tag "evac" in the form for fast routing.

Marco (People Ops): Apply here: https://forms.redwood/etf-apply — attach docs and put "etf-priority" in the subject. Backup-care micro-grant enrollment on that form too.

peopleops-bot: Reminder set: anyone on company-funded travel will receive a short Code of Conduct acknowledgement prompt during preapproval. Reimbursements for company-funded trips will be on hold until ack is complete.

Jess (Eng): Is the CoC ack only for offsites or also for customer visits?

Tess (People Ops): It applies to all company-funded travel including offsites, customer visits, and vendor-hosted events that Redwood pays for. Personal trips are unaffected. If you need an accommodation for the acknowledgement, DM People Ops.

Marco (People Ops): We'll host a 20-minute AMA tomorrow 1pm PT in #people-ops-ama to walk through examples and repayment scenarios. If you need a confidential consult, DM People Ops and we'll schedule a private review.

Hannah (Payroll): Quick note: if you prefer a manual review before submission, reply here and we can walk through the form privately.

Tess (People Ops): Thanks all — links and full FAQ: https://docs.redwood/internal/emergency-travel-fund. :heart:
